sentences.text:
Shri Pradeep Kumar Naveriya - Advocate for the appellan
 Ms. Shanti Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for the respondent Sta
Heard on I.A.No.13255/2024, which is an application filed on behalf of t h e appellants seeking
temporary suspension of sentence and grant of temporary bail to the appellants on the ground that
mother of appellant No. 1 and mother-in-law of appellant No. 2 has expired on 27.5.2024 and his
last ritual ceremony is scheduled for 6.6.2024.
The appellants have been convicted by the trial Court under Sections 304B/34, 315/34, 498A of Ipc
and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years, 5 years, 3
years and 2 years with fine of Rs.5000/-, Rs.2000/-, Rs.2000/- and Rs.1000/- respectively with
default stipulation.
In the first round counsel for the State was directed to verify the factum of death of mother of the appellant.
Counsel for the State has verified the factum of death of mother of appellant No. 1 and mother-in-law of appellant No. 2, namely Smt. Mannu Bai Ahirwar.
It is contended by the counsel that she has expired on 27.5.2024.
In view of the aforesaid, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if n o t already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the appellants shall remain suspended temporarily and they shall be released on temporary bail with direction to surrender before the trial Court concerned on or before 10 th June, 2024.
If the appellants fail to surrender before the trial Court concerned on or before the aforesaid date,
the trial Court would be at liberty to take steps to take the appellants into custody.
List the matter thereafter awaiting the report regarding surrender of the appellant in terms of this order.
